_about: The unused science-image pool for the Clinical studies blog cards (Malcolm, 2026-09-29: no model/branding images on the blog; use images from earlier runs not yet on the website). Every ref on the Desktop sheets ~/Desktop/skingenetix-study-images-{ARG,CU,PDRN,GEN}-n.png resolves here to its file. Built from a pixel match of 2,846 candidates against all 896 Shopify images: 115 matched live images were excluded (resized copies by NCC, crops by SIFT + NCC). Not a shortlist: every unused candidate in these four pools is listed. Order per pool: no person or product (by type), then a hand, then a product in frame.
